skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze trends in responsible tourism and the development of ecotourism.
Demonstrate awareness and responsibility towards the environment, and a positive attitude towards the conservation and sustainable use of tourism resources.
Analyze and determine marketing models in ecotourism.
Understand the role of ecotourism in economic, social, and environmental aspects.
Conduct research on the role of organizations and individuals in ecotourism.
Analyze and synthesize the characteristics, conditions, and basic principles of ecotourism.
Present group reports and defend them in class discussions.
Work in groups to develop and present case studies on ecotourism.
Calculate the carrying capacity of ecotourism destinations based on various indicators and conditions.
Develop plans and strategies for ecotourism management and business.
